vb_textbox.text: Choose a gnome and stay loyal to the same gnome unless it gives you 2 or less mushrooms.  If it gives you 2 or less, switch to the other gnome.  Remain loyal to that gnome unless it gives you 2 or less in which case switch again.  Keep doing this until the end of the game.  This will teach the gnomes about supply and demand.  Good luck!
